remarks: Spacious, light filled, and totally renovated. Make this beautiful 2 bed, 2 full bath apartment in downtown your new home. Perfectly maintained and tastefully renovated. HUGE master suite with new bath and walk in closet. Large and fully updated kitchen with wonderful open flow to living and potential dining area. Second bedroom with full renovated updated bath. Washer/Dryer in unit and two assigned off street parking spaces. Cats allowed, no dogs. Electric car charger available for tenant use. Easy access to I-95 and the train station. Walk to downtown restaurants and bars. References and excellent credit required.
